coverage: Retained activities in my own saved plan; this does not include all course actions.
limits: Planned minutes and budget describe intention, not verified time spent.
Course counts describe saved lesson, submission or reflection actions; they do not claim a passed assessment, qualification or job impact.
Planned and completion dates are independent. Open attention counts can overlap. Items with missing or future completion dates are not counted as completed in the week.
No private notes, goals, activity titles, evidence, contact details or account/workspace/task identifiers are included.
